indicators.field: Military and Security: Military and security forces
indicators.value: no regular military forces; the Mauritius Police Force (MPF) under the Ministry of Defense includes a paramilitary unit known as the Special Mobile Force, which includes some motorized infantry and light armored units; the MPF also has a Police Helicopter Squadron, a Special Support Unit (riot police), and the National Coast Guard (also includes an air squadron) (2024)

indicators.field: Transnational Issues: Refugees and internally displaced persons - refugees (country of origin)
